overview.name: Roundhill T-REX 2x Long DRAM Daily Target ETF
overview.description: The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that are designed to provide, in the aggregate, 200% exposure to the price performance of DRAM on a daily basis. It is non-diversified.
